title: Mid-Scale Concept Alignment & Magnitude Calibration
intuition: Checks whether adversarial training preserves both the orientation (cosine >= 0.85) and calibrated magnitude (in [0.75, 1.25]) of opposing positive and negative concept vectors at intermediate scale.
failure_mode: Scale-uncalibrated step sizes or unbounded critic slopes either overshoot the target magnitude (>1.25) or shrink concept vectors below 0.75.
protocol_notes: 800-step Tier-2 required behavioral host verifying directional and scale fidelity.
